reason: RouteMoA routes queries in a Mixture-of-Agents pool with a lightweight scorer that screens candidate models before any inference and a judge mixture that corrects scores, cutting MoA cost by 89.8% and latency by 63.6% in large pools; it is inference-time model routing at the agent-framework level rather than a serving system for a model.
title: RouteMoA: Dynamic Routing without Pre-Inference Boosts Efficient Mixture-of-Agents
